findings: No 94-symbol manifest, instrument identifiers, venue mappings, contract specifications, time zones, or provider provenance hashes were supplied, so exact-instrument integrity cannot be verified.

The DEV/VALIDATION/FINAL date boundaries are not precisely defined. Because prior evidence is known through 2026-07-31, FINAL must begin strictly after that date and remain inaccessible until all rules are frozen.
OKX fallback continuity criteria are unspecified. Uncontrolled provider stitching can introduce timestamp, price-scale, volume, spread, or candle-construction inconsistencies.
Forex M5-to-H1 construction rules, session calendar, DST handling, missing-bar policy, bid/ask convention, and executable-cost model are unspecified.

The per-symbol coordinate-search space lacks explicit finite bounds for families, hours, entry geometry, tie-breaking, and stopping rules, creating researcher-degrees-of-freedom and multiple-testing risk.
Eligible-day handling is not fully operationalized: eligibility must be determined before outcomes, retained in an audit ledger, and produce exactly 1–3 executions without silent deletion.
Conservative same-bar SL handling is stated but incomplete; deterministic ordering is also required for bars touching entry, stop, and target, gaps, duplicate signals, and simultaneous orders.

The 80% minimum win-rate and positive-expectancy requirements need prespecified sample-size and uncertainty gates; point estimates alone are insufficient and must not be described as performance without deterministic replay.
review.proposal: Freeze a versioned 94-symbol manifest and a finite per-symbol search grid before testing. Preserve raw immutable downloads with request metadata, checksums, venue/provider identifiers, timestamps, and transformation lineage. Define exact UTC candle construction, session/DST rules, fallback precedence, overlap checks, gap thresholds, price normalization, spread/fee/slippage assumptions, and deterministic intrabar/gap execution rules. Partition chronologically into DEV and VALIDATION using only data through 2026-07-31; keep early-August onward sealed as FINAL and never use it for selection, debugging, thresholds, or retries. On DEV, enumerate only the frozen H1 family/hour/entry-geometry coordinates independently per symbol. Select with deterministic tie-breaking and multiplicity-aware robustness criteria, then permit one locked VALIDATION replay. Record every calendar day, eligibility decision, signal, execution, rejection reason, and the enforced 1–3 eligible-day executions. Require minimum trade/day counts, positive net expectancy after costs, and a prespecified lower confidence bound compatible with the 80% win-rate requirement. Freeze code, data hashes, parameters, and environment before any single deterministic FINAL replay; report FINAL results without subsequent tuning.
evidence: The contract explicitly requires 94 independent symbols, exact-instrument data, 1–3 eligible-day executions, RR in {1,2}, at least 80% win rate, positive expectancy, and forbids pooling, symbol deletion, fabrication, leakage, silent eligible-day deletion, and FINAL tuning.
Prior V64/V69/V73 evidence is explicitly labeled exposed development rather than untouched out-of-sample evidence and is usable only as a bounded hypothesis seed through 2026-07-31.

The supplied method identifies per-symbol H1 family/hour/entry-geometry coordinate search and conservative same-bar SL, but provides no manifest, datasets, hashes, code, parameter grid, replay logs, or precise partition boundaries for verification.
Under the stated contract, deterministic replay—not prior claims or exploratory statistics—is the sole admissible performance truth.

review.proposal: Proceed with the bounded per-symbol research plan. For each symbol, define a fixed development window (e.g., up to 2026-07-31) and a validation window (early-August onward) that is never used for tuning. Use deterministic replay with a fixed seed and exact data snapshots to evaluate all candidate geometries. Record per-symbol win rate and expectancy against the 80% and positive expectancy thresholds. If any symbol fails, do not delete it; instead, mark it as non-tradeable and exclude from the final portfolio. Maintain a full audit log of data sources, fallback triggers, and any continuity checks. Do not use FINAL results for any tuning decision; only report them after all development is frozen.
